_help: Transcriptions of Ian's CUSTOM card backs (bios and stats in his own words). Shown in the card viewer under "Read the back" (custom cards only, only while the back is on screen) and read aloud by screen readers. Key: the Drive file ID of the card's back scan (stays the same when a file is renamed). Fields: "name" (reminder), "text" (the whole back: paragraphs separated by a blank line; "## " starts a heading; lines with " | " form a table), and, to feed the player page's "From my custom card" section: "player" (the player page slug), "facts" ([["Born", "July 10, 1906"], ...]) and "stats" ({"title": "...", "rows": [[header...], [row...]]}). Only add facts and stats the player page does not already show. Optional "story" replaces "text" on the player page.
